attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: order-fulfillment-routing

steps:
  - id: fetch_order_details
    op: data/fetch
    params:
      source: orders_database
      trigger: order_confirmed
      description: Fetch the confirmed order details ready for fulfillment
    output: order_details

  - id: validate_order_schema
    op: validate/schema
    params:
      input: "{{ order_details }}"
      schema: fulfillment_order_schema
      description: Validate the order against the fulfillment schema
    output: validated_order

  - id: check_inventory
    op: inventory/check
    params:
      items: "{{ validated_order.items }}"
      use_cache: false
      description: Check current inventory availability with a fresh lookup
    output: inventory_status

  - id: validate_inventory_status
    op: validate/schema
    params:
      input: "{{ inventory_status }}"
      schema: inventory_status_schema
      description: Validate the inventory status data before routing decisions
    output: validated_inventory_status

  - id: route_fulfillment
    op: decision/route
    params:
      condition: "{{ validated_inventory_status.all_items_available }}"
      routes:
        - when: true
          path: in_stock_fulfillment
          label: in-stock
        - when: false
          path: backorder_fulfillment
          label: backorder
      order_id: "{{ validated_order.order_id }}"
      description: Route order to in-stock or backorder fulfillment path based on availability
    output: routing_decision

  - id: notify_supplier_backorder
    op: notification/send
    params:
      recipient: supplier
      channel: email
      message: "Order {{ validated_order.order_id }} has been routed to backorder fulfillment. Items requiring restock: {{ validated_inventory_status.unavailable_items }}"
      description: Notify the supplier when the order is routed to the backorder path
    condition: "{{ routing_decision.label == 'backorder' }}"
    output: supplier_notification_result

  - id: log_fulfillment_decision
    op: audit/log
    params:
      order_id: "{{ validated_order.order_id }}"
      routing_path: "{{ routing_decision.label }}"
      inventory_snapshot: "{{ validated_inventory_status }}"
      supplier_notified: "{{ routing_decision.label == 'backorder' }}"
      timestamp: "{{ now() }}"
      description: Log the fulfillment routing decision for audit purposes
    output: audit_log_entry
